0x0021FF.en: 「The power of the Granzon... learn it firsthand.」

0x00223C.en: 「Let me show you/ the power of the Granzon.」

0x0022D9.en: 「No one alive/ can bind me, you know.」

0x002329.en: 「To those who bar my path... I show no mercy.」

0x0023A9.en: 「Defying my master?/ You don't know your place!」

0x002424.en: 「Now, I'll show off the Granzon's cheat power,/ full blast!」

0x00248F.en: 「Chika.../ Where did you learn a word like that?」

0x0024DF.en: 「I see... So this is the Masou Kishin Granveil.../ Indeed, it seems we have crossed paths/ more than once before.」

0x002578.en: 「Huang Yang Long.../ The data and my memory still don't match, but.../ you seem a formidable foe indeed.」

0x002611.en: 「Granveil.../ Superb firepower, but poor defenses, is that so?/ I see, there should be a way to handle it.」

0x0026AA.en: 「That attitude, that tone, that manner.../ Something about it nags at me.」

0x002706.en: 「Valsione... oh, fascinating data./ Indeed, our ties run deep, it seems.」

0x002795.en: 「I've grasped most of the data.../ but that girl Lune, it seems,/ can't be measured by data alone.」

0x002843.en: 「A Masou Kishin pilot summoned to Langran.../ Ahmed Hammoudi.../ The name does seem familiar.」

0x0028D9.en: 「I see.../ I've grasped the specs of that machine, Solgady./ The rest depends on Ahmed's strength...」

0x00296F.en: 「Interesting... this man Ahmed./ If he weren't an enemy,/ he could be quite useful...」

0x0029FF.en: 「Your part is over now,/ Louzorl. Exit the stage.」

0x002A67.en: 「You stole my freedom.../ That sin is worth a thousand deaths./ Ready yourself, Louzorl.」

0x002B19.en: 「In a sense,/ you may be a necessary evil...」

0x002BC5.en: 「You will never become a perfect being.」

0x002C05.en: 「Quite the actor, aren't you,/ Alteur Steinbeck.」

0x002CA1.en: 「Heh.../ Can you make me feel fear and despair?」

0x002CFA.en: 「Let me teach you what true fear is.」

0x002D87.en: 「That one can't be dismissed as chance either...」

0x002DCD.en: 「You're the one who'll be swallowed by chaos.」

0x002E10.en: 「Leaving it be/ could cause trouble down the line...」

0x002E7B.en: 「You Guests/ are enemies I must destroy.」

0x002ECB.en: 「You shall share/ the same fate as the Inspectors.」

0x002F21.en: 「The power of Granzon, elevated by me.../ Learn it firsthand.」

0x002F83.en: 「Guest and Inspector alike,/ before this Granzon you are powerless.」

0x003028.en: 「I told you before,/ your power won't last much longer.」

0x003087.en: 「Shall we bring this to an end soon,/ Lord Zezernan.」

0x003102.en: 「A paradise? In another world,/ I did catch a glimpse of one.」

0x00314F.en: 「How about you try dying/ for yourself, just once?」

0x00319C.en: 「I'll humor your boredom for a while./ After that,/ you'll have no time left at all, kukuku.」

0x003235.en: 「I can predict where that one is headed...」

0x003278.en: 「Heh.../ What do you hope to learn from me?」

0x0032F0.en: 「In a sense, it may be/ much like my Granzon...」

0x003349.en: 「It could become a nuisance later on...」

0x0033CC.en: 「Erde Mitte.../ You can easily imagine/ where AI1 will end up, can't you?」

0x003441.en: 「I count myself among those who love the Earth...」

0x00348A.en: 「Not even a god can bind me./ A man-made god, all the more so.」

0x0034F2.en: 「I see.../ So you are Euzeth Gozzo.」

0x00353F.en: 「The end you'll meet is the same.../ You can't escape the cycle of rebirth.」

0x00359B.en: 「You cannot undo the chains of causality./ Not while we stand here.」

0x003683.en: 「This is your due for defying me.」

0x003890.en: 「It seems this is as far as I go...」

0x003948.en: 「!?/ To go this far.../ I underestimated you, it seems.」

0x0039D0.en: 「Mgh! This power.../ It exceeds my expectations.」

0x003A26.en: 「Ngh... I see,/ so you're desperate too.」

0x003AAA.en: 「Not bad./ But it isn't over yet.」

0x003B3B.en: 「M-Master, Master!!/ It's bad, it's bad,/ it's baaaaad!」

0x003BEA.en: 「Waaaah!!/ I'm gonna die, dyin', dead, let's die!」

0x003C37.en: 「...You panic too much, Chika./ And your grammar's off. Monica's influence, perhaps...」

0x003CF5.en: 「What.../ Power this great was a bit unexpected.」

0x003DDB.en: 「The more you struggle,/ the more the chains tangle, Euzeth.」

0x003EDA.en: 「Mm... you'd fight me with that?/ ...Heh, how foolish...」

0x003F33.en: 「Not bad.../ But the real match starts now.」

0x003F83.en: 「Ho, so you landed a direct hit.」

0x003FB1.en: 「Tsk!/ ...But this much still/ won't defeat me.」

0x00400E.en: 「Ngh... you managed a decent attack for once.」

0x0040A4.en: 「Ho... a fine attack./ But it lacks the power to finish.」

0x004109.en: 「I see, so that's your move./ Not a bad attack.」

0x004153.en: 「Hm, you struck a good spot./ Quite the skill.」

0x0041E9.en: 「Ho.../ It seems I need to revise/ my assessment of you a little.」

0x004280.en: 「But Master won't go down/ to something like this! Yes, that's right!/ Master is invincible!」

0x00434A.en: 「I-I'll have you know!/ That was just a fluke!/ When Master gets serious, this is nothing!」

0x0043E0.en: 「Hoh.../ So the Flame Masou Kishin's reputation is no exaggeration.」

0x00442D.en: 「Hm... more power than that frame lets on.../ So it's true.../ this really is an evolution of Valsion.」

0x0044C3.en: 「...I've reassessed you, Ahmed./ To think your strength was this great...」

0x004525.en: 「...It's clearly a cut above a mass-produced unit.」

0x00455F.en: 「...It's about time/ I put an end to this rivalry between us.」

0x0045B5.en: 「Granzon isn't as fragile/ as you think.」

0x00464B.en: 「Kouryu,/ is that all your act has to offer?」

0x0046CC.en: 「I won't be made into your sacrifice.」

0x00470F.en: 「Did I take the Melior Esse too lightly...」

0x004755.en: 「Heh... the name "King of Ruin"/ is no empty title, it seems.」

0x0047AB.en: 「Even if you absorbed Granzon,/ you would...」

0x0047FE.en: 「Gan Eden,/ I want no part of your logic.」

0x00485A.en: 「A bit of a nuisance, that machine.」

0x004888.en: 「Same old routine.../ Don't you ever get tired of this, Euzeth?」

0x004906.en: 「You think you can beat me/ with that much?」

0x004A6D.en: 「You think you can/　beat me with that much?」

0x004ABD.en: 「......I thought you'd/　put up a better attack than that.../　What a disappointment.」

0x004B3E.en: 「Heh... get serious, or/　this'll take years off your life.」

0x004B94.en: 「Hmph... well,/　I'll praise you for landing it, at least.」

0x004BE4.en: 「So feeble.../　And you call that a challenge...」

0x004C31.en: 「......Is that your best?/　Don't disappoint me.」

0x004CA0.en: 「No sweat at all, ya greenhorn!/　Go wash your face and try again/　the day before yesterday!」

0x004D24.en: 「What's wrong?/　Is that all you've got, Yang Long?」

0x004DAB.en: 「Not enough power, sad to say, Ahmed.」

0x004E25.en: 「Even with the Guests' power,/　you can't defeat this Granzon.」

0x004EBE.en: 「You mean to defeat my Granzon/ with that, Lord Zezernan?」

0x004F11.en: 「Your fate, and AI1's,/　mean nothing to me.」

0x004F61.en: 「Heh, you actually think you can scare me...」

0x004FA1.en: 「Is that all the "Lord of Ruin" can do?」

0x004FDB.en: 「Calling yourself a god with power like this.../　Laughable.」

0x005034.en: 「......Is that all?/　Don't disappoint me, false god.」

0x005093.en: 「Is that all./　The outcome was clear from the start, Euzeth.」

0x005149.en: 「Where are you aiming?/　I'm right here.」

0x00520E.en: 「Even if it hits,/　it makes no difference......」

0x005264.en: 「A do-or-die attack? The height of folly.」

0x0052DC.en: 「Right you are!/　Thinking you could take on my master with that,/　you're seriously out of your league!」

0x0053F0.en: 「Your prized power/　is meaningless if it misses, Yang Long.」

0x005452.en: 「I see, nice moves./　But there's too much wasted motion, Lune.」

0x005556.en: 「Whatever machine it is,/　if you're the one piloting......」

0x005627.en: 「And with that you'd ruin the world...」

0x005661.en: 「Heh.../　If you're going to call yourself a god,/　you'll need to show me more than that.」

0x00573E.en: 「Can't you see it, Euzeth? Your fate.」

0x005781.en: 「Is that all there is to it?」

0x005853.en: 「Momentum alone won't/　be enough to defeat me.」

0x0058FD.en: 「Can't reach from there....../　Well, that's fine.」

0x00594D.en: 「Sniping from afar, how petty!/　You chicken!」

0x0059A9.en: 「......So there's no countering that, huh./　Can't be helped.」

0x005AD3.en: 「You can leave the rest to me.」

0x005B60.en: 「Good grief,/　leaving me to clean up after you? Masaki.」

0x005BB0.en: 「It may be meddling, but/　I'll help you, Presia.」

0x005CB5.en: 「They still have some use left, after all.」

0x005DDA.en: 「I'll cover you. We're allies for now, after all.」

0x005E1D.en: 「Ah, I'm not calling it atonement,/　so rest easy.」

0x005F47.en: 「Too slow. Let me give you one more.」
